svg.text: Measurement happens twice: cheap and family-blind before matching, then again with the family known.
PHASE 1 · Classified stage — before matching, chunks of 8
PHASE 2 · Refine — post-match, serial, cheap-first / most-eliminating-first
from here on the image's FamilyIDRecord is known
phase-1 edge intersections already sit in the snapshot, so this is the big cut
Analyzer_SubjectGeometry (shares one subject box) → DominantColors → ProductColor
then SubjectDetector (classical CV, chroma + texture, never lightness)
→ Analyzer_ShadowPresence. Last, because it is steered by the colours above.
first fully-satisfied rule in ImageRoles.json wins; otherwise the provisional pick
survives only while the pool still contains it
each wave eliminates the ones with
DetOrderRules.json maps phenotype → _det slot per product type
filename hints and confidence only break ties
Every feature starts at UNKNOWN and is only overwritten by a real measurement. A model's UseIt toggle does not skip its
analyzer — the gate sits inside, at the point the model's output would be consumed, so a closed gate simply leaves UNKNOWN.
